events.effect: If the Fed raises rates in December, Americans will rush to lock mortgage rates and move savings to higher-yield accounts.
A further rate rise in January makes car loans and card debt dearer, so more people refinance or transfer balances early in 2027.
If Bitcoin drops to $60,000 before year-end, more people will look up the price and how to buy or sell.
If GTA VI wins Game of the Year in December, demand for the game and for PS5 consoles rises further into Christmas.
If crude oil falls to $80 in November, petrol gets cheaper and drivers compare pump prices and plan more car trips.
If a US-Iran ceasefire starts by year-end, fuel prices ease and people book flights through the Gulf again early in 2027.
If Anthropic lists by mid-December, first-time investors will open brokerage accounts and search how to buy the shares.
If Google ends 2026 with the top-rated AI model, more people will try Gemini and look at its paid plan in January.
